newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Aug trade surplus widens to $15.4 bln.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Aug trade surplus widens to $15.4 bln.

text.p: Russia posted a trade surplus of $15.4 billion in the first eight months of this year against a $12.5 billion surplus in the same period of 1995, State Statistic Committee figures showed.
RUSSIAN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Aug 96 Jan-July96 Jan-Aug 95
RUSSIAN MERCHANDISE TRADE Aug 96 July 96 Aug 95

On October 11, Interfax news agency quoted the State Customs Committee as saying Russia posted a trade surplus of $23.61 billion in the first eight months of this year, with $44.8 billion in exports but $21.2 billion in imports.

NOTES - Figures in billion dollars, FOB. Data are for trade with Russia's "far abroad" excluding former Soviet states. Including trade with CIS countries, the surplus in the first eight months narrowed to $14.4 billion from $14.9 billion last year.
